reference_note: Every RESIST depth below is FM 3-06.11 (Jan 2002), Chapter 7, for a single 7.62-mm NATO ball round at 25 m. The reference round's velocity is TM 43-0001-27's M80 figure, measured 78 ft (23.8 m) from the muzzle, i.e. at the same range as the FM table.

reference_round.source: TM 43-0001-27 (C1-8), Cartridge, 7.62mm, Ball, M80: projectile weight 149 gr, velocity 2750 fps 78 ft from muzzle; diameter .308 in per NIJ Standard-0101.06 Table (7.62 mm NATO FMJ, .308 in)

wood.source: FM 3-06.11 Table 7-3, pine board, 25 m: 13 in

soil.source: FM 3-06.11 Table 7-3, dry loose sand, 25 m: 5 in

metal.source: FM 3-06.11 Table 7-5, mild steel door 3/8 in, 1 round to penetrate at 25 m: the round got through, so 3/8 in is a lower bound on its depth

glass.source: FM 3-06.11 para 7-3c: the 7.62-mm round can penetrate a windowpane at a 45-degree obliquity. A glass block is treated as a window, not as a metre of solid glass; no loss is modelled.

foliage.source: Design: leaves and plants are concealment, not cover. No measured loss.

unknown.source: No data: a block of an unrecognised material stops the bullet (no wall is made shoot-through by guessing).
